abilities.desc_en: If 3 or more Backfire charges expires simultaneously, the opponent takes Shock Damage equal to {{var_8}} of Attack Rating over {{var_9}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 网络蜜蜂的毒素会恶意攻击敌人的神经通路。

abilities.desc_en: Scorponok’s robotic bee Dazes the opponent, causing their Basic Ranged Attacks to Miss {{var_12}} of the time and Ranged Special Attacks to Miss {{var_13}} of the time for {{var_14}}seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 天蝎座善于制造惊喜。

abilities.desc_en: After each Heavy Attack, this bot gains a Beast Fury buff that grants Attacks a {{var_29}}~{{var_30}} chance to be Unblockable for {{var_31}}.
